name: Packaging & Logistics Automation Production Line
summary: Logistics automation system integration solutions covering the entire process of post-production packaging, conveying, and sorting.
contentHtml:
Packaging and logistics automation production lines are system integration solutions provided by TXAM for post-production logistics.

Solution Components

The system covers the entire process including automatic case opening, packing, case sealing, labeling, sorting, conveying, palletizing, and warehouse integration.

Technical Advantages

  • Full-process automation, greatly improving logistics efficiency
  • High-speed sorting system with sorting accuracy above 99.9%
  • Intelligent conveying scheduling for high equipment utilization
  • Seamless integration with WMS system for transparent information
  • Modular design for flexible expansion
  • Complete line integration with one-stop delivery

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, system integration, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: Packaging Efficiency Bottleneck
painPoints.desc: Manual packaging is slow and cannot meet the takt time requirements of high-speed production lines

painPoints.title: Insufficient Sorting Accuracy
painPoints.desc: Manual sorting has a high error rate, resulting in low logistics efficiency

painPoints.title: Conveying Process Discontinuity
painPoints.desc: Poor conveying between production lines and warehouses creates logistics bottlenecks

painPoints.title: Fragmented Information Systems
painPoints.desc: Packaging, conveying, and sorting systems operate independently with no information sharing

painPoints.title: Low Space Utilization
painPoints.desc: Traditional logistics layouts occupy large spaces and result in low warehouse efficiency

painPoints.title: Limited Scalability
painPoints.desc: Difficult to adapt to capacity fluctuations and business expansion needs
